gallery.title: File:Reeve37258.jpg
gallery.artist: Otis Historical Archives National Museum of Health and Medicine
gallery.description: St. Elizabeth's Hospital. Wall of room in Ward Retreat 1. Reproductions made by a patient, a disturbed case of dementia praecox; pin or fingernail used to scratch paint from wall, top coat of paint buff color, superimposed upon a brick red coat of paint. Pictures symbolize events in patient's past life and represent a mild state of mental regression. Undated, but likely early 20th century. Selected by Kathleen.
categories: Flickr images uploaded by Flickr upload bot
